slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
未成年人请不要打赏，成年人也请量力而行，免费小说，能看下去并且不养书就是最大支持喵。
慢热文。
多女主。
标签里有的。
------------------------
“宿主！你给我听着！”
“我听着呢！”
一架马车之中，一名金发猫耳小萝莉和一名头发金色看起来十分帅气的男子互相对峙中。
猫耳小萝莉是系统。
金发男子是林恩。
系统双手插腰，怒目而视，气鼓鼓的骂道：“我是黄毛系统，不是美少女攻略系统，谁叫你不当反派黄毛的，现在好了吧，我被爱神开除了，你也被流放了。”
林恩垂头丧气道：“我也不想啊！我只是想获得幸福！”随后双手捂脸哭着说：“谁知道破灭的结局还是来了。”
系统气的直跺脚：“都怪你啊，你想要幸福就听我好好的去把女主们都给恶堕不就是了。”
林恩依旧不想听系统的诡辩，反驳道：“我想要的是真心相爱，如同小说一样的梦幻幸福生活，不是要把各个女主角都变成只会举剪刀手的奴隶啊！”拿出手帕擦眼泪：“在蓝星也就算了，穿越异世界依旧过的那么烂。”
系统用鄙夷的目光看着林恩：“啧，你这家伙就是一条臭虫，不管到哪里都那么可悲。”
“你妈的，要你管！”
“因为你，我失业了！”
林恩，一名蓝星穿越者，胎穿到这个异世界，成为前世凤傲天游戏里的反派黄毛，恶役少爷，帝国的大公的三儿子。
原本游戏里的剧情就是破灭结局，不管游戏哪条线都会迎接属于林恩的破灭结局。
凤傲天单身线中，林恩结局是对抗魔族的战场上想给凤傲天使绊子，结果导致侧翼被攻破，害死大皇子而被流放成为男爵，最后被哥布林攻下领地，被钉在十字架上烧死。

皇女线中，结局是给皇女下药被凤傲天抓包，然后被剥夺贵族身份，最后死在下城区。
圣女线中，结局是因为玷污圣女被狂信徒打死。
还有老萝莉魔女线，精灵公主线，银龙王线，后宫线，全部都是死死死死。
这就是林恩的命运。
然而，在即将临来破灭结局的时候觉醒前世记忆，还获得了来自邪神给的系统，名叫黄毛系统。
任务很简单，去牛了凤傲天，打击凤傲天的心理和气运，然后把凤傲天本人也拿下。
因为身为邪神的爱神是凤傲天的敌人，邪神们不想看见救世主拯救世界。
与之相对的，拿下女主们后，黄毛就能过上他的幸福人生了。
只可惜的是，林恩是个“纯爱”战士，坚决不接受这些女主们堕落。
系统没办法，为了主人的任务，只能选择帮我去追人，反正只要让凤傲天和其他也能当凤傲天的女主们都给变成不努力的样子就行了。
系统认为满脑子是林恩和“满脑子是林恩”这两个其实区别不大。
结果很明显，林恩一个人都没追到，迎来了破灭结局，系统也因此被爱神抛弃了。
好在这次的破灭是全新结局。
不再是因为犯愚而破灭，而是在于被政敌攻击。
自己的大哥和二哥也在攻击他。
因为按照均分继承制，所有贵族都要给每个儿子分地。
林恩不是私生子，有继承权，所以干掉林恩后，自己的两个哥哥在父亲死后就能获得更多的封地了。
世子之争向来如此。
更别提帝国天才三皇女是他的未婚妻，圣女曾经是他的青梅竹马。
你问为什么三皇女是他的未婚妻？

因为林恩从小的魔法和斗气天赋牛逼也是个天才，加上三皇女几乎和他同龄，自己的两位哥哥是双胞胎，出生的早，都已经有婚约了。
林恩所在的公爵家可以说很强大，就那么说吧，即使拆成三块，也就被削弱到了正常公爵的实力。
content_en:
Minors please don't tip, adults please do what you can, free novels, if you can read them and don't keep books, that's the greatest support.
Slow writing.
Many heroines.
It's in the label.
--------------------------
"Host! Listen to me!"
"I'm listening!"
In a carriage, a little girl with blond cat ears and a very handsome man with blond hair were facing each other.
The cat-eared little loli is the system.
The blond man is Lynn.
The system put its hands on its waist, glared angrily, and cursed angrily: "I am a yellow-haired system, not a beautiful girl guide system. Who told you not to be the villain yellow-haired? It's okay now. I was fired by the God of Love, and you were also exiled."
Lin En said dejectedly: "I don't want to either! I just want to be happy!" Then he covered his face with his hands and cried, "Who knew that the end of destruction would still come."
The system stomped its feet angrily: "It's all your fault. If you want to be happy, just listen to me and turn all the heroines into evil."
Lin En still didn't want to listen to the system's sophistry and retorted: "What I want is to love each other sincerely and live a dreamy happy life like a novel. I don't want to turn each heroine into a slave who can only raise scissor hands!" He took out a handkerchief to wipe his tears: "Forget it in Blue Star, living in another world is still so bad."
The system looked at Lin En with contempt: "Tsk, you are just a bedbug, you are so pathetic no matter where you go."
"Damn it, I need you to take care of it!"
"Because of you, I lost my job!"
Lin En, a Blue Star traveler, traveled to this different world and became the villain Huang Mao in Feng Aotian's game in his previous life, a villainous young master, and the third son of the Grand Duke of the empire.
The plot in the original game is the ending of destruction. No matter which line of the game, Linn will be greeted with the ending of destruction.
In Feng Aotian's single line, Lin En ended up trying to trip up Feng Ao Angel on the battlefield against the demons. As a result, his flank was breached, killing the eldest prince and being exiled as a baron. Finally, he was captured by goblins and burned to death on a cross.
In the princess line, the ending is that Feng Aotian was caught drugging the princess, then deprived of her noble status, and finally died in Xiacheng District.
In the saint line, the ending is that he was beaten to death by a fanatical believer for defiling the saint.
There are also the old loli witch line, the elf princess line, the silver dragon king line, and the harem line, all of which are dead to death.
This was Lynn's fate.
However, when he was about to face the end of destruction, he awakened the memory of his past life and obtained a system from the evil god called the Huangmao System.
The mission is very simple. Get rid of Feng Aotian, attack Feng Aotian's psychology and luck, and then take down Feng Aotian himself.
Because as the evil god, the God of Love is Feng Aotian's enemy, the evil gods don't want to see the savior save the world.
On the contrary, after winning the heroines, Huang Mao can live his happy life.
It's a pity that Lin En is a "pure love" warrior and resolutely refuses to accept the depravity of these heroines.
The system has no choice. For the master's mission, it can only choose to help me chase people. Anyway, it only needs to make Feng Aotian and other heroines who can also be Feng Aotian look like they don't work hard.
The system believes that there is not much difference between having a head full of Lynn and "a head full of Lynn".
The result is obvious. Linn didn't catch anyone, ushered in the ending of destruction, and the system was abandoned by the God of Love.
Fortunately, this destruction is a new ending.
It is no longer a matter of being foolish and being disillusioned, but of being attacked by political opponents.
His eldest brother and second brother are also attacking him.
Because according to the equal inheritance system, all nobles must allocate land to each son.
Lin En is not an illegitimate child and has the right to inherit, so after killing Lin En, his two brothers will be able to obtain more fiefdoms after their father's death.
The struggle between the heir apparent has always been like this.
Not to mention the genius of the third princess of the empire isHis fiancée, the Saint, was once his childhood sweetheart.
You ask why the third princess is his fiancée?
Because Lin En has been a genius since he was a child with great talent in magic and fighting spirit. In addition, the third princess is almost the same age as him. His two brothers are twins. They were born early and are already engaged.
The Duke's family that Linn belongs to can be said to be very powerful. Let's put it that way. Even if it is broken into three pieces, it will be weakened to the strength of a normal Duke.
